title: Release quest 0.10.0 carrying the rerouted managed agent-instructions block
description: The owner chose on 2026-09-24 to cut 0.10.0 now rather than hold it. It is minor rather than patch because QCLI-362 changes the managed block content, so every consumer check reports drift (exit 6) until the block is regenerated. That regeneration is scheduled fleet-wide by opum-agent under OPAG-378 once this is published. git log v0.9.0..origin/dev shows QCLI-362 is the only source change since 0.9.0 (src/application/agents/agent-instructions.ts). Procedure: docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md, with QCLI-347 (0.9.0) as the precedent.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every version site the runbook lists reads 0.10.0, and a grep for 0.9.0 across src, fixtures, .claude-plugin and package.json returns only intended history
All six platform packages are rebuilt at 0.10.0; check:packages, test:packages and the repository check pass
CHANGELOG names a 0.10.0 section with a fresh empty Unreleased above it
v0.10.0 is tagged on main, and the qualification run against the tag produces a native-execution receipt that receipt:require accepts
@opum-ai/quest 0.10.0 and all six platform packages are published, and a real consumer install reports 0.10.0 and emits the QCLI-362 block

finalSummary:
quest 0.10.0 is published and live: the wrapper and all six platform packages. This was checked from the consumer side, not from the publisher exit code.

Why this release: the owner chose on 2026-09-24 to cut it now, from a two-option ask. It carries QCLI-362, the managed block that routes readers to the guides. It is minor because that change makes every existing block report drift (exit 6) until it is regenerated. Since 0.9.0 the only source changes are agent-instructions.ts and the two version constants.

Path, following the runbook with QCLI-347 as the precedent:
- PR #243, three commits:
  - strings 0ea4c27: every listed site, the platform manifests and bun.lock; check:packages exited 0 strings-only;
  - bytes cdea240: all six platforms built locally with bun 1.3.14;
  - changelog: 0.10.0 named, with a fresh empty Unreleased above it.
- One correction before merge: my own changelog line claimed the src diff touched one file, when it touches three (two are version constants). Caught by running the diff.
- Local gates passed: check:packages, test:packages, npm run check with 593 pass.
- QCLI-271 ordering followed. The untouched darwin-arm64 build was copied aside and all executions ran first, including the CLAUDE.md block regeneration (version-only to current). The file was then recreated (inode 37977477 to 37977666, sha256 bbc94ed2 unchanged), and git status exited 0.
- Promotion PR #244: main fast-forwarded b66ca56 to bf30c5c on the first push, using the QCLI-364 predicate that also waits out older pending rows.
- Tag v0.10.0 (annotated 90a8d0e, peels to bf30c5c). Qualification was dispatched against the tag: run 35959762162, all 10 jobs success. receipt:require accepted the receipt, which binds 0.10.0 at bf30c5c across six platforms.
- Publish via scripts/publish-release.mjs on the Keychain token route. The keychain was already readable, so no unlock or OTP was needed. The publisher dry run passed first.

Verified after publish:
- The wrapper took 5 polls, about 2 minutes, to become visible. That is the documented read lag, not a failure, and nothing was republished.
- dist-tags.latest is 0.10.0, and all six platform packages are at 0.10.0.
- A clean npm install @opum-ai/quest@0.10.0 resolves quest-darwin-arm64 and reports 0.10.0. Its instructions block names the task guides and --accountable-human, and has no Backlog recipe lines.
- receipt:verify-published: the receipt matches every published platform package.

Stated plainly, not dressed up: there was NO opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt for this pair. opum-doc ADR harden-fleet-ci-against-a-single-runner-outage-and-unqualified-publication (main 9222079, recorded 2026-09-24T04:21Z) says a publication missing such a receipt should be treated as blocked until the override mechanism exists. The orchestrator said not to interrupt this release for it, and I read the ADR itself only after publishing. The ADR names publish-release.sh, which opum-agent owns, so whether it already bound this repo publisher is arguable. The gate is filed as QCLI-366.

Versions: quest 0.10.0, bun 1.3.14, lore 0.9.0.
